mapper.sql: select s.service_item_id, s.category_id, c.category_name, s.service_name, s.org_id, s.service_sub_title, s.service_cover, s.service_cover_storage, s.service_cover_object_key, s.service_desc, s.service_content, s.service_duration, s.sale_type, s.base_price, s.unit_name, s.need_manual_confirm, s.allow_assign_worker, s.show_in_miniapp, s.show_in_portal, s.status, s.del_flag, s.create_by, s.create_time, s.update_by, s.update_time, s.remark from hm_service_item s left join hm_service_category c on s.category_id = c.category_id
mapper.select: select sku_id, service_item_id, sku_name, price, original_price, duration_minute, sort_no, status from hm_service_sku where service_item_id = #{serviceItemId} order by sort_no asc, sku_id asc

select extra_item_id, service_item_id, extra_name, extra_price, charge_type, sort_no, status from hm_service_extra_item where service_item_id = #{serviceItemId} order by sort_no asc, extra_item_id asc

select rule_id, service_item_id, advance_days, min_advance_minutes, max_advance_days, allow_same_day, time_slots_json, cancel_rule_json, status from hm_booking_rule where service_item_id = #{serviceItemId}
mapper.update: update hm_booking_rule set advance_days = #{advanceDays}, min_advance_minutes = #{minAdvanceMinutes}, max_advance_days = #{maxAdvanceDays}, allow_same_day = #{allowSameDay}, time_slots_json = #{timeSlotsJson}, cancel_rule_json = #{cancelRuleJson}, status = #{status} where service_item_id = #{serviceItemId}
mapper.select: select area_id from hm_service_item_area_rel where service_item_id = #{serviceItemId}

select area_id, province_code, province_name, city_code, city_name, district_code, district_name, area_name, org_id, extra_fee, status from hm_service_area
1 = 1
and area_name like concat('%', #{areaName}, '%')
and status = #{status}
order by area_id desc
select area_id, province_code, province_name, city_code, city_name, district_code, district_name, area_name, org_id, extra_fee, status from hm_service_area where area_id = #{areaId}
mapper.update: update hm_service_area set province_code = #{provinceCode}, province_name = #{provinceName}, city_code = #{cityCode}, city_name = #{cityName}, district_code = #{districtCode}, district_name = #{districtName}, area_name = #{areaName}, org_id = #{orgId}, extra_fee = #{extraFee}, status = #{status} where area_id = #{areaId}
mapper.select: select category_id, parent_id, category_name, category_icon, banner_image, sort_no, show_in_miniapp, show_in_portal, status from hm_service_category where del_flag = '0' and status = '0' and show_in_miniapp = '1' order by sort_no asc, category_id asc
where s.del_flag = '0' and s.status = '0' and s.show_in_miniapp = '1' order by s.service_item_id desc limit 6
